topic: Skipping gap insurance on a car bought with little down vs adding it for a few dollars a month (Luther vs Judith)

scenes.narration: A totaled car can leave you paying for scrap metal. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard showing a crushed car with a loan balance floating above it, comic burst banner reads PAYING FOR NOTHING, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Luther and Judith both finance a thirty thousand dollar car with nothing down.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split clinic panel of man luther and woman judith each signing at a dealer, a tag reads ZERO DOWN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cars lose twenty percent of their value in the first year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a car rolling off a lot with a price tag dropping from THIRTY THOUSAND to TWENTY FOUR THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Luther declines gap coverage. Another upsell, he figures.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man luther waving off a dealer form reading GAP COVERAGE, a thought bubble reads UPSELL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ten months later a truck runs a red light and totals the car.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a crushed sedan at an intersection, a truck with a red light behind it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Insurance pays twenty three thousand. The loan balance is twenty eight thousand.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a check reading TWENTY THREE THOUSAND beside a loan statement reading TWENTY EIGHT THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Luther owes five thousand dollars on a car in a scrapyard.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man luther writing a check while looking at a crushed car in a scrapyard, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Judith adds gap insurance through her insurer for six dollars a month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman judith checking a box on her insurance app reading GAP COVERAGE SIX DOLLARS MONTHLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her car is totaled in the same kind of crash the same year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a second crushed sedan, woman judith unharmed on the curb, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Insurance pays twenty three thousand. Gap pays the remaining five.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two checks reading TWENTY THREE THOUSAND and FIVE THOUSAND GAP, a loan stamped PAID, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She walks away owing nothing and buys her next car with a clean slate.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman judith holding keys to a new car, a tag reads ZERO OWED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Little down? Add gap coverage until you are above water. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard reading ADD GAP UNTIL YOU ARE ABOVE WATER, a healthy loan chart behind her, kids comic book illustration
